facts.fact: The Director General of the Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Resident Services Agency is reported in January 2025 as saying the agency's plan to digitise all its services is in a pilot phase, with 21 of the city's 116 woredas already digitised; the report does not say which services, or whether births and deaths are entered digitally.
